title.narrative: Assistance nutritionnelle aux populations vulnérables dans les régions de Gao, Ménaka et Mopti, et aux nouveaux réfugiés dans les régions de Mopti, Bandiagara et San.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide nutrition assistance to vulnerable children and women affected by food insecurity and newly arrived refugees in Menaka, Gao, Mopti, Bandiagara and San. This UNICEF project provides life-saving nutritional assistance to children under five years of age affected by severe acute malnutrition (SAM) to reduce child mortality through screening and treatment, by supporting pregnant and lactating women and by strengthening access to health and nutrition services. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 223,000 people, including 55,000 women, 168,000 children, and including over 11,000 persons with disabilities.
